episodes.title: L'attacco
episodes.overview: A female rower becomes the coxswain of a dysfunctional all-boys rowing team.

episodes.title: Gli odiosi otto
episodes.overview: Easton's rowing team struggles to find their rhythm ahead of an alumni race as egos clash over the stroke seat. Ella stresses about Teagan's tuition.

episodes.title: La squadra decolla
episodes.overview: Family rivalry heats up between Josh and Ryder during a first-class birthday celebration. Cam guides Teagan in her bid to earn the team's trust.

episodes.title: Puro remanticismo
episodes.overview: As the team gears up for its first away race, Teagan grapples with competing interests off the water. Brittany floats a tempting proposition.

episodes.title: Anatomia di un ballo d'autunno
episodes.overview: Teagan's grand entrance at Easton's fall formal turns heads — and hearts. But the night gets choppy when unexpected emotions threaten to spoil the fun.

episodes.title: Brutta rottura
episodes.overview: After a suspicious setback during a key race against Westvale, Noah's mystery-themed after-party becomes a real-life investigation in the boathouse.

episodes.title: Sotto pressione
episodes.overview: Competing under scout scrutiny at the indoor qualifiers, Easton's top rowers grapple with secret struggles, personal sacrifices and Olympic ambitions.

episodes.title: O timoniere, mio timoniere
episodes.overview: Oars at the ready! A pivotal final race on home waters tests the team's integrity and resilience as old mistakes give way to new beginnings.
